mapper.select: SELECT id, username, status, todo, detail, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt FROM todos where username = #{username} and status = #{status} order by id asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todos (status,username,todo, detail, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{status}, #{username}, #{todo}, #{detail}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
